lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with a higher spatial density observed in the mid-lateral region compared to the ventral-lateral area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadow transition on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, which appear more diffuse and less structured than the primary lateral constellation.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple slender, high-luminance teleost fish (remoras) located ventral to the pectoral fin and trailing along the lower flank.
